description: Picks the major scale that best matches a chord played into it and rounds a separate melody to that scale; the maker describes the module as unfinished

inputs.text: The notes of the chord that chooses the scale, one per channel, read while the matching channel of chord gate is above 2V; the major scale holding most of those notes is the one used
A channel above 2V puts the note on that channel of chord v/oct into the chord, and dropping below 2V takes it out again
The pitches to be rounded to the chosen scale, and the number of channels here sets the number of channels at quantized melody

outputs.text: Each channel of melody v/oct rounded to the nearest note of the chosen scale, kept in the octave it arrived in
The first note of the chosen scale as a pitch inside one octave, 0V for C up to 0.917V for B
10V in any sample in which a note of the chord changed, and 0V in every other sample
The seven notes of the chosen scale as a polyphonic signal, one per channel, from 0V for C up to 0.917V for B

notes: the scale is C major until a chord is played in, so a melody is rounded to the white notes before the chord inputs have been used
a note joins the chord while its channel of chord gate is above 2V, so the chord inputs do nothing without gates; the notes alone are not read
